_about: Recomp design tokens, taken from the live web app (version 2026-10-16 r15). Names match the CSS custom properties. Use these as the single source for the native theme. Light and dark have the same keys.

roles.surface-2: Inputs, nested rows, quiet fills inside a card.
roles.ink: Primary text and the black + button.
roles.muted: Labels, captions, units. Never for body copy you must read.
roles.line / line-soft: Hairline dividers and borders. Prefer line-soft inside cards.
roles.accent: THE one fill colour: the single primary button per screen, progress rings, the running-timer card. Never decoration.
roles.accent-ink: Accent on a light ground (olive in light mode, lime in dark). Use for text and small marks that must read as accent.
roles.on-accent: Text and icons on an accent fill.
roles.warn: Gentle alerts: missed sessions, a limit habit over its cap, missed days in Consistency.
roles.danger: Destructive actions and real errors only.
roles.gold: Keystone habit star and rare highlights.
roles.pause-bg / pause-ink: The quote card only. Stays dark in both themes so it reads as a pause between action cards.

typography.family: Jost (Google Fonts), fallback system-ui, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
typography.numbers: Same family with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums). No monospace anywhere.

card-title.use: Session name in the hero, card headings

quote.use: Quote card line; long quotes over 100 characters step down to 21-28

stat-value.use: kcal left, protein to go, steps

motion.view-enter: slideIn 340ms cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1): opacity 0 to 1, translateX 22px to 0
motion.card-enter: rise 460ms cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.28,1): opacity 0 to 1, translateY 14px to 0
motion.reduced-motion: All of the above off when the OS asks for reduced motion.

layout.note: Phone column is the only layout. On a wide screen the web build shows the column as a framed device; the native app needs no tablet layout for testing.
